Selects each establishment's most recent food inspection score, averages those latest scores within each Montgomery census tract, and ranks tracts from lowest to highest average score with tract name and geoid retained for mapping.
sql:
WITH latest_inspections AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    entity_key,
    value,
    event_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_key ORDER BY event_date DESC, record_id) AS rn
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_624311'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND geoid IS NOT NULL
    AND value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  AVG(CAST(l.value AS DOUBLE)) AS average_latest_food_inspection_score,
  COUNT(*) AS facility_count,
  t.geoid
FROM latest_inspections l
JOIN fw_pg.tracts t ON t.geoid = l.geoid
WHERE l.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.name, t.geoid
ORDER BY average_latest_food_inspection_score ASC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200
